_doc: 환경 탐지용 경로·도구 목록 — 🔴 **단일 출처**. py와 sh가 둘 다 여기를 읽는다.
_why: 같은 사실('nvidia-smi가 PATH에 없을 수 있다')이 payload/P4.sh 와 sei_pilot/sysprobe.py 두 곳에 적혀 있다가 한쪽만 고쳐져 GPU를 못 찾았다(lead 관측, 같은 유형 5번째). 값을 복제하지 않는 것이 유일한 근본 대책이다.
_extra_search_paths_note: WSL의 nvidia-smi는 /usr/lib/wsl/lib 에 있고 PATH에 없다(lead 실측). 컨테이너·모듈 환경에서도 유사 사례가 있어 함께 넣었다.
_qc_env_vars_note: Gaussian16은 모듈/스크립트로 환경을 잡는 경우가 많아 실행 파일이 PATH에 없어도 이 변수들로 위치를 알 수 있다. 🔴 이 목록을 셸에 다시 적지 마라(5번째 중복의 교훈).

xtb._note: 동봉본을 **가장 먼저** 시도한다. 실행 실패(아키텍처 등)는 사유를 기록하고 컨테이너→모듈→PATH 로 넘어간다.

_vendored_tools_note: 🔴 사용자 클러스터에 xtb 가 없어 P3(조합 폭발 계수)가 SKIP 됐다. 정적 링크 바이너리를 동봉해 되살린다. 출처·라이선스·체크섬은 vendor/xtb/PROVENANCE.json.
_gpu_tools_note: 이 도구를 찾을 때 위 경로를 함께 뒤진다.

gaussian_modules._doc: 🔴 Gaussian 모듈 이름 — **단일 출처**. 코드·payload 에 박지 마라.
gaussian_modules._why: 로그인 PATH 의 바이너리로 찾으면 잡 스크립트에 module load 가 안 들어가 계산 노드에서 P1/P1b/P5 가 전부 rc=3 으로 죽었다(실클러스터 확인).
gaussian_modules._default_source: MEASURED on the cluster: `module avail` lists gaussian/g16.c01.linda. 🔴 The previous value 'gaussian/g16.c01.lin' did not exist — it was the rstrip('(default)') truncation baked into config, and every Gaussian job died with 'Unable to locate a modulefile'. Override with --gaussian-module.
gaussian_modules._fallback_note: Tried in order **only if the previous candidate does not yield a runnable binary**. 🔴 `module load` exit status is NOT the success signal on this site: loading a non-existent modulefile printed ERROR:105 yet we recorded state='loaded'. Success = the binary appears and is executable. Which candidate won is recorded in the reply.

engine_requirements._doc: 🔴 THREE-ROW AVAILABILITY CHECK -- one row per external code. Single source; do not restate any of this in a shell script or a Python constant.
engine_requirements._why: We wrote the data-library row for CP2K ($CP2K_DATA_DIR, U-46) as a COMMENT and never implemented it, and never carried it to VASP at all. ADR-073/074 then found we had never checked whether VASP can compute anything: `vasp_std 6.4.3 present at <path>` sat inside a block headed 'settled [MEASURED] -- do not re-run these'. 🔴 PRESENT != CAN COMPUTE. Row 1 alone must never be read as readiness.

data_library.note: the `gen` basis decks are OURS and ship in the package; $GAUSS_EXEDIR is the site's. Both are 'the data the code needs' and both can be missing separately.

g16.launch_smoke: a single-point on a 3-atom system, ON A COMPUTE NODE (ADR-041). `command -v g16` proves a name is on PATH; a wrapper script, a missing licence or a broken Linda install all pass that and fail this.

data_library.path_source: [MEASURED] user reply, R36.1/C3. Per-element POTCARs, variant Li_sv, ENCUT 520 eV -- matches SevenNet-0's MPtrj pretraining reference.
data_library.note: 🔴 R36.1's own caveat: POTCARs existing != VASP running, and neither is VASP COST, which has NEVER been measured on this cluster (U-69).

vasp_std.launch_smoke: 🔴 NOT RUN. V-P2 was CANCELLED by the user (R36.6) on direct experience that VASP runs here. That closes AVAILABILITY only. Our own pipeline has still never invoked VASP (U-74), and V-2a'`s first 5-frame sub-gate carries that. If those frames fail, read PLUMBING before physics.

data_library.note: the vendored copy ships its own share/xtb. 🔴 xtb caches a GFN-FF topology in the WORKING DIRECTORY and reuses it on the next run -- isolate a directory per run or structure 2 silently inherits structure 1's topology.

xtb.launch_smoke: one GFN2 single point. 🔴 Judge on 'energy parsed and finite', NOT on the 'normal termination' banner: xtb 6.7.1 omits the banner for periodic GFN-FF single points that produced perfectly good energies.

data_library.note: U-46. This is the row that was written as a comment and never implemented.

cp2k.launch_smoke: one GFN1-xTB or DFT single point on a compute node.

data_library.note: 🔴 LAMMPS being allowed does NOT make ReaxFF allowed -- separate user decision, recorded in sysprobe.EXCLUDED_ENGINES.
